name: John Novak
biography: John Novak is a Technical Director at Praetorian with a deep interest in cryptography, reverse engineering, and embedded firmware. His evolution to computer security and hacker culture began with an undergraduate degree in mathematics followed by ten years of cryptography, security research, and exploit development at a previous employer. His current role at Praetorian includes conducting numerous security assessments for IoT devices, web applications, mobile applications, and (on occasion) cloud services. @novak@infosec.exchange (Mastodon)
